name: ddd-authoring
description: DDD workflow authoring and publish pipeline

scripts.deploy: pnpm run test:preflight && pnpm run build && pnpm run test:pack && node dist/tooling/deploy/deploy-local.mjs
scripts.deploy:dry-run: pnpm run test:preflight && pnpm run build && pnpm run test:pack && node dist/tooling/deploy/deploy-local.mjs --dry-run
scripts.deploy:check: pnpm run test:preflight && pnpm run build && node dist/tooling/deploy/deploy-local.mjs --home-dir /tmp/ddd-workflow-deploy-check --skip-skills
